question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 'human'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is the definition of the figure of speech 'personification' as it gives human attributes to something that is non-human.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'human'. 
 
• 'Human' means 'relating to people.'
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

​

Correct Sentence:__ * Personification gives __human__ qualities to non-living things or ideas.*
